question: Should this profile README adopt PinMe-generated repository cards instead of the current concise, owner-curated Markdown project list?
rationale: The vision explicitly makes profile presentation an owner-controlled editorial choice and requires external live content to earn its reliability and privacy cost.

options.title: Keep the curated Markdown
options.body: Retain the current canonical links and concise descriptions, avoiding an additional live third-party image dependency.

options.title: Trial PinMe cards
options.body: Approve a narrow README change only after confirming the cards render through GitHub, use appropriate public data, and have acceptable service reliability.

recommendation.title: Keep the curated Markdown
recommendation.body: Retain the current canonical links and concise descriptions, avoiding an additional live third-party image dependency.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the repository owner and the documented recent author of the README’s project-presentation changes.
